mathematics: Complete source and target LP cubes [0,1]^n with actual objective sum(x)+7. The caller restricts the original input by H=sum(x)<=0, and optionally also objective=7. One complete identity map checks every output bound, objective equality, and all n retained-coordinate observations. The appended domain rows are level first and halfspace second. Independent Fraction checks establish the complete zero point lies in the restricted input; no nonempty optimum or whole-model contract is inferred.
sampling: Six fixed loads in listed order, three fresh author/assembler preparations, nine fresh verification processes and three separate /usr/bin/time -l RSS samples. Warm filesystem cache after preparation, no cache flush. Every status/statistics/RSS result is retained; no failures omitted. This absolute baseline measures complete-model copy and domain construction, not proof search or speedup against unsupported older rules.
preparation: Independent documented-format MCM writer, complete RPA/caller request, full identity and exact restricted-point checks. Preparation wall includes author process and assembler. Direct MCM generation does not imply measured MPS canonicalization. This third matrix leaves prior subflow and strict/image matrices unchanged.
isolation: Diagnostic correctness runs may overlap other functional validation and are excluded from formal performance. Official timing awaits root explicit clear and final cold-binary rebinding without changing workloads or sample counts.
